titles.romaji: Yubisaki Annainin Shirudaku Settai Okawari Sanhaime
titles.native: 指先案内人 汁だく接待 おかわり三杯目

description:
Based on the adult game by Waffle.

A much coveted beauty salon popular among young ladies is actually a trap for innocent young women. Guided slowly into perverse activities, they are filmed in secret and blackmailed by the manager and assistant.
